headline: Bitcoin Recovers to $80,800 Ahead of Federal Reserve Meeting
summary: Bitcoin rebounded to the $80,800 level as digital asset traders positioned ahead of the upcoming Federal Reserve monetary policy decision.
why: Cryptocurrency markets remain sensitive to US interest rate expectations and broader global dollar liquidity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Trading sentiment strengthened ahead of the Fed rate decision, pushing BTC toward $80,800.

why_moved: Bitcoin advanced back to $80,800 as investors repositioned digital asset holdings in anticipation of the Federal Reserve's rate announcement.
